ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; surface is >95% low-intensity dark pixels with sparse high-intensity white point-source pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation macro-structure; high-intensity pixels are distributed as discrete, non-contiguous focal spots (1-3px diameter) across the surface of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 1/8th of the fluke's vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude (2-5 pixel) serrations; distinct larger indentations are visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the medial trailing edge, transitioning to a slight concavity near the tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of numerous circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed stochastically across the ventral surface, with higher density near the lower margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) detected on the mid-left lobe and the lower central region near the fluke base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jagged edge irregularities and pixel clusters at the outer distal tips of both lobes, indicating significant edge trauma or heavy biological colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of distinct orange-hued pixel clusters (biological organisms) at the extreme lateral margins of both fluke tips.
